title: Channel
description: Just the picture of an old CRT, filling the whole frame on black: each channel is a Beatles album cover drifting under scanlines and a phosphor mask while a lyric caption builds word by word. Drag, scroll or tap the screen and it tears into snow, rolls and lands on the next channel with a green channel number in the corner.
intent: Changing channel as a physical, audible event with nothing between you and the glass: dragging detunes the picture into snow before it snaps to the next station, a vertical roll settles, degauss wobbles the colours back to true, and herb's beat comes through a small TV speaker.
sources: herb reference board: fa23 Y2K montage (old CRT TV with a console), e936 and 70e0 lyric captions
